description_en: Queries the statistics of asset exposure analysis
description_zh: 查询资产暴露分析的统计信息
name: DescribeExposedStatistics

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member account in the resource directory, which is an Alibaba Cloud account. You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

ExposedAsapVulCount.description_en: The total number of high-severity vulnerabilities exposed to the Internet that can be exploited by attackers
ExposedAsapVulCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上可被黑客利用的高危漏洞总数量

ExposedComponentCount.description_en: The total number of system components, such as OpenSSL and OpenSSH, on your servers that are exposed to the Internet
ExposedComponentCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的您服务器的系统组件（例如OpenSSL、OpenSSH）总数量

ExposedDdsCount.description_en: The number of ApsaraDB for MongoDB database assets exposed to the Internet
ExposedDdsCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的MONGODB数据库资产数量

ExposedEcsCount.description_en: The number of ECS assets exposed to the Internet
ExposedEcsCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的ECS资产数量

ExposedInstanceCount.description_en: The total number of assets exposed to the Internet
ExposedInstanceCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的资产总数量

ExposedIpCount.description_en: The total number of IP addresses exposed to the Internet
ExposedIpCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的IP地址总数量

ExposedKvstoreCount.description_en: The number of ApsaraDB for Redis database assets exposed to the Internet
ExposedKvstoreCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的RDS-Redis版数据库资产数量

ExposedLaterVulCount.description_en: The total number of medium-severity vulnerabilities exposed to the Internet that can be exploited by attackers
ExposedLaterVulCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上可被黑客利用的中危漏洞总数量

ExposedNntfVulCount.description_en: The total number of low-severity vulnerabilities exposed to the Internet that can be exploited by attackers
ExposedNntfVulCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上可被黑客利用的低危漏洞总数量

ExposedPortCount.description_en: The total number of ports exposed to the Internet
ExposedPortCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的端口总数量

ExposedRdsCount.description_en: The number of ApsaraDB RDS database assets exposed to the Internet
ExposedRdsCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的RDS数据库资产数量

ExposedWeekPasswordMachineCount.description_en: The total number of system keys on your servers that are exposed to the Internet
ExposedWeekPasswordMachineCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的您服务器的系统密钥的总数量

GatewayAssetCount.description_en: The total number of gateway assets, such as load balancers and NAT gateways, that are exposed to the Internet
GatewayAssetCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的网关资产（负载均衡、NAT网关）总数量

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
